name: Show All XP Gains
description:
Lowers the XP threshold that controls when the experience gain bar appears shows to 1 XP, so all XP gains are shown.

By default the game hides any gain under 20 XP,  which means low XP rates will often never show a popup even though you do receive the XP. This makes every gain visible. Purely a tiny UI change. This does NOT alter how much XP you actually earn.
author: SSyl
